findings.title: Cisco Security Advisory cisco-sa-onprem-fmc-authbypass-5JPp45V2 - CVE-2026-20079
findings.summary_md: Cisco published the original advisory for CVE-2026-20079 (CVSS 10.0, CWE-288 authentication bypass) on March 4, 2026. The vulnerability stems from an improper system process created at boot time that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute scripts and obtain root access. Fixed releases listed include 7.0.10, 7.2.12, 7.4.8, 7.6.6, 7.7.13, 10.0.2, and 10.1.0. The advisory states no workarounds are available.

findings.title: Cisco Security Advisory cisco-sa-fmc-static-cred-BET3Cjh - CVE-2026-20316
findings.summary_md: Cisco published the advisory for CVE-2026-20316 (CVSS 5.3, CWE-259 hardcoded static credentials) on July 29, 2026. The vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to log in using a low-privileged account and access sensitive data within FMC software. The advisory notes no workarounds exist and lists the same fixed releases as the authentication bypass advisory, emphasizing the vulnerability can be chained for privilege elevation.

findings.title: Cisco Talos Threat Advisory - Active Exploitation of FMC Vulnerabilities (UAT-12197, UAT-11823, UAT-11988)
findings.summary_md: Cisco Talos reported on September 9, 2026 that it was actively tracking exploitation of CVE-2026-20079 and CVE-2026-20316 in the wild. Talos identified three independent clusters: UAT-12197 (web shell and JAR-based command executor), UAT-11823 (Sandworm-linked APT deploying Netcat reverse shells and a Cyclops Blink variant), and UAT-11988 (Qilin ransomware affiliate using static credentials and tunneling). The post includes Snort SIDs 66075-66080, 66883, and 66960-66961, plus IoC hashes and attacker IP addresses.

findings.title: CISA Adds CVE-2026-20079 to Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog
findings.summary_md: On September 9, 2026, CISA added CVE-2026-20079 (Cisco Firewall Management Center authentication bypass) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. The alert notes the vulnerability allows malicious actors to gain total control of affected assets and directs federal agencies to prioritize rapid remediation under BOD 26-04.
